title: Tom's Day
text:
Tom wakes up at seven o'clock every day. He has a shower and eats a small breakfast. Then he walks to the bus stop. The bus takes him to work.

At six o'clock, Tom finishes work and goes home. He cooks dinner with his wife. After dinner, they watch TV together. Tom goes to bed at ten o'clock.

questions.text: What time does Tom wake up?
What do Tom and his wife do after dinner?
options: They walk to the bus stop

questions.text: Why does Tom probably feel tired at the end of the day?
What kind of person is Tom?
options: A person who does not like his wife

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day
washing your body by standing under running water
the main meal of the evening

paragraph_translations: Tom se despierta a las siete en punto todos los días. Se ducha y come un desayuno pequeño. Después camina hasta la parada del autobús. El autobús lo lleva al trabajo.
A las seis en punto, Tom termina el trabajo y vuelve a casa. Cocina la cena con su esposa. Después de cenar, ven la televisión juntos. Tom se acuesta a las diez en punto.
